scripts.build: npm run check && node scripts/build-map.mjs && node scripts/checkenv.mjs && cross-env NODE_OPTIONS="--no-deprecation --max-old-space-size=8000" PAYLOAD_MIGRATING=1 payload migrate && cross-env NODE_OPTIONS=--no-deprecation PAYLOAD_MIGRATING=1 payload run scripts/seed.ts && cross-env NODE_OPTIONS="--no-deprecation --max-old-space-size=8000" next build
scripts.seed: cross-env NODE_OPTIONS=--no-deprecation PAYLOAD_MIGRATING=1 payload run scripts/seed.ts
scripts.lint: eslint src/map src/music src/plate scripts tests
scripts.format: prettier --write src/map src/music src/plate scripts tests
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm test
scripts.verify: npm run check && npm run build:map && node tests/e2e/sweep.mjs --local-map && node tests/e2e/sweep.mjs --local-map --phone && node tests/e2e/sweep.mjs --local-map --size=360x640 && node tests/e2e/sweep.mjs --local-map --size=844x390 && node tests/e2e/visual.mjs
